acceptance: The pandas-df trunk UAT shard completes without a watchdog memory kill, with the cause of the 13 GiB breach recorded.
context:
Filed 2026-11-22 while closing out the run-timeout follow-ups (umbrella run-timeout-plan-20261120). Evidence was read on 2026-11-22; re-read run logs, file paths and line numbers before acting.

Owner decisions 2026-11-22 (choice dialog): "Fix forward; never raise the budget": find the cell and cause (bisect locally under the lock at 13 GiB), fix it; budget, cells and scale stay; if the cause is outside BenchBox, record and block. Delivered as a serial item, not in a batch ("Same, but UAT investigations separate").
description:
## Problem
Trunk UAT run 45007293835 (2026-11-22) failed job `UAT stage 1 pandas-df` (137161944440; checkout d7197c9c12): at 10:51:18Z, about 15 minutes into the sweep and before any cell output was printed, the host-lock watchdog logged `BREACH tree footprint: measured 13.07 GiB, limit 13.00 GiB budget (BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MEMORY_BUDGET_GIB); action: kill` with one `benchbox` process (pid 4705) at 12.84 GiB, and the job ended with exit 79. The cell running at 10:51Z is not named in the job log; the shard artifact and the runner's `log_dir` `/home/runner/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_20261122_103636` hold the cell logs (the datavault cells printed later ran at 11:35Z).
Regression window: pandas-df passed in Trunk UAT 44888589677 (3e09d4f43b, 2026-11-21). `git log 3e09d4f43b..d7197c9c12` has 10 commits, among them the run-timeout pull requests #4423, #4434, #4435, #4437 and #4439; check #4437 (stop UAT cells with the run time limit, remove unused timers) first. Related, not the same: release-uat-dataframe-runner-shutdown-20261030 (open), pandas-df-write-primitives-sf1-segfault (done).

## Change
From the shard artifact, name the killed cell and its peak memory, and compare with the 11-21 run. Bisect the 10-commit window for that cell (lock-taken local runs at the same 13 GiB budget) and fix the cause.

## Decision gates
- Do not raise `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MEMORY_BUDGET_GIB`, drop the cell, or lower its scale without the owner's decision in a choice dialog, with the measured peak.
- If a merge in the window is the cause, name it with evidence (peak before and after) before proposing a fix or revert; a revert of develop needs `make trunk-revert` rules, not a hand revert.
- A larger or paid runner needs owner approval.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the killed cell, its peak and the causing commit recorded on this item; a fix that keeps the cell under the budget, shown by its peak RSS in a trunk UAT pandas-df shard or a lock-taken local reproduction with the same budget, before and after; or the owner's recorded decision.
Fail: the shard passes only because the cell was skipped or the budget raised without the owner.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
